ecole.cp.h1: Free 1st Grade Games: Letters, Numbers and Time
ecole.cp.titre_seo: Free 1st Grade Games | Free Micro Games
ecole.cp.description_seo: Free 1st grade games: learn letters, count bus passengers, read a clock, finish patterns. First grade math and reading games, no sign-up, offline too.
ecole.cp.intro:
These 1st grade games match what first graders practice in class: letters, early reading, counting and telling time. Letter Balloons asks you to pop every balloon showing a given letter, and Letter Constellations has you tap letter stars in order to spell space words. The Nest of the Alphabet Baby Dinos hides letters on rolling eggs, which keeps young eyes alert.

For first grade math, Count the Bus Passengers adds and takes away riders on the number 7 bus before it pulls away. What Time Is It? starts with o'clock and half past, then moves on to quarters and minutes. The Magic Necklace is a pattern game: look at the row of beads and pick the missing ones.

All {n} games are made for ages 4 to 6, so a 1st grader can play them alone. Short sessions after school work well, and each game picks up again at the last level reached.

faq.q: Are these games right for a 6-year-old in 1st grade?
faq.r: Yes. They start at 4, 5 or 6 years old, and the clock and bus games line up with first grade math.

faq.q: Can my first grader play without an account?
faq.r: Yes, no account is needed and nothing is paid. Your child just picks a game.

faq.q: Do the reading games work offline?
faq.r: Once opened with internet, Letter Balloons and the others stay on the device and work offline.

faq.q: Can we use a phone for practice at home?
faq.r: Yes, a phone or tablet is enough, and a computer works too.

ecole.ce1.h1: Free 2nd Grade Games: Math, Spelling and Clocks
ecole.ce1.titre_seo: Free 2nd Grade Games | Free Micro Games
ecole.ce1.description_seo: Free 2nd grade games: give change in acorns, read clocks, start times tables and spell space words. Six math and spelling games, one with online play.
ecole.ce1.intro:
These 2nd grade games follow the year when adding, subtracting and spelling become everyday tools. At the till of The Squirrels' Grocery Store, forest animals pay for their shopping and you hand back change in acorns. Count the Bus Passengers practices adding and taking away, and What Time Is It? moves from whole hours to quarters and minutes.

Times Table Race gives a first taste of multiplication, with a running fox that only clears an obstacle when the product is correct. The Pots of the Gourmet Market is about reaching an exact weight with carrots, tomatoes and pumpkins, played against robot cooks or real players online.

For spelling practice, The Lost Words of the Orbital Station scrambles a crackling radio message: grab each drifting letter and put the words back in order. The {n} games are made for ages 6 and 7, the usual age at the start of 2nd grade.

faq.q: What age are the 2nd grade games for?
faq.r: These games are marked 6+ or 7+, which fits most second graders aged 7 to 8.

faq.q: Can two 2nd graders play together?
faq.r: The Pots of the Gourmet Market lets them play online. Without internet, they can play it solo against robots.

faq.q: Is it free and without sign-up?
faq.r: Yes, both: no price, no account and no email address.

faq.q: Do the games work on a tablet?
faq.r: Yes, on tablets, phones and computers, by touch or with a mouse.

ecole.ce2.h1: Free 3rd Grade Games: Multiplication and Logic
ecole.ce2.titre_seo: Free 3rd Grade Games | Free Micro Games
ecole.ce2.description_seo: Free 3rd grade games: multiplication races, basketball sums, exact potions and horse sudoku. Eight math and logic games for ages 7 and 8, with no sign-up.
ecole.ce2.intro:
These 3rd grade games put multiplication at the center, as third grade does. Times Table Race asks a multiplication question at every obstacle on the forest track. Hoops of the Exact Score goes further: each basketball shot adds 3, takes away 2 or doubles the score, and you must land exactly on the number shown.

Exact amounts appear in several games. In The Little Apprentice Wizard's Potions, every recipe needs an exact number of moon drops; Feeding Time at Linden Tree Stables weighs carrots, oats and hay for each horse, and The Squirrels' Grocery Store practices giving change. Horse Sudoku adds logic, with eight horses instead of numbers.

The Lost Words of the Orbital Station keeps spelling going, and The Pots of the Gourmet Market can be played online with other players. The {n} games are for ages 7 and 8.

faq.q: Which game helps with multiplication in 3rd grade?
faq.r: Times Table Race is built around the times tables. Hoops of the Exact Score adds doubling shots to mental math.

faq.q: Can my child play offline?
faq.r: Yes. After a first launch with internet, the sudoku, potions and races are stored and work offline.

faq.q: Is there anything to pay?
faq.r: No. All {n} games are free and there's no account to set up.

faq.q: Can a third grader play on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, by touch on a phone or tablet, or with a mouse and keyboard on a computer.

ecole.cm1.h1: Free 4th Grade Games: Math Puzzles and Spelling
ecole.cm1.titre_seo: Free 4th Grade Games | Free Micro Games
ecole.cm1.description_seo: Free 4th grade games: exact sums on the court, horse rations, potion drops, sudoku and word wagons. Five math and logic games for ages 8 and 9, no sign-up.
ecole.cm1.intro:
These 4th grade games are for kids who already know their tables and want problems with several steps. Hoops of the Exact Score mixes +3, −2 and ×2 shots, so you have to plan a few baskets ahead to reach the scoreboard number. In Feeding Time at Linden Tree Stables, each horse needs an exact ration, weighed on a balance scale and then served against the clock.

The Little Apprentice Wizard's Potions asks for exactly the right number of drops, while a cat keeps knocking bottles over. Horse Sudoku trains logic on a grid of funny horses, with stars and treasures to collect.

For words, The Mixed-Up Word Wagons, from age 9, asks you to move jumbled letter cars around a rail yard to spell the word shown in the picture. The {n} games are for ages 8 and 9, and none of them needs a sign-up.

faq.q: What age are these 4th grade games for?
faq.r: They are marked 8+ or 9+, which suits most fourth graders aged 9 to 10.

faq.q: Do they work without Wi-Fi?
faq.r: Yes. Open each game one time while online and it stays saved for offline play.

faq.q: Do the 4th grade games cost anything?
faq.r: No, they are free from the first level to the last.

faq.q: Which devices can my child use?
faq.r: Phones, tablets and computers. You can play with a fingertip or a keyboard.

ecole.cm2.h1: Free 5th Grade Games: Logic and Word Puzzles
ecole.cm2.titre_seo: Free 5th Grade Games | Free Micro Games
ecole.cm2.description_seo: Free 5th grade games: balance King Barnaby's scales and rebuild words with letter wagons. Math logic and spelling puzzles for ages 9 to 11, no sign-up.
ecole.cm2.intro:
These 5th grade games are picked for kids of 10 and 11. King Barnaby's Scales is a math logic puzzle: the treasurer has mixed up the king's weights, and you place sacks, gold bars and cheeses so every scale in the castle stays level. It asks you to compare, add and reason about balance, the kind of thinking 5th grade math builds on.

The Mixed-Up Word Wagons is a spelling puzzle set in a rail yard. Someone parked the letter cars in the wrong order, and each level is solved when the train spells the pictured word again. The harder levels need a plan before the first move.

The 10-12 age page also has strategy and logic games, such as Run Your City and Ludus Coriovalli, that suit 5th graders well.

faq.q: What age are the 5th grade games for?
faq.r: King Barnaby's Scales is marked 10+ and the word wagons 9+, a good fit for fifth graders.

faq.q: Are the 5th grade games free?
faq.r: Yes, these games are free and need no account or email.

faq.q: Can we play them offline?
faq.r: Yes. Once each game has been opened with internet, it keeps working on the device without a connection.

faq.q: Do they work on a phone?
faq.r: Yes, by touch on phones and tablets, and with a mouse on a computer.
